run_human_agent: run a human agent in DeepMind Memory Tasks using WASD and arrow keys for control
run_with_custom_level: run the human agent with a custom level name and environment seed via flags
run_with_docker_image: run the human agent using a specified Docker image name for the Memory Tasks environment
review_KEYS_TO_ACTION: review the keyboard to action mapping dictionary that maps WASD and arrow keys to agent movements
review_NO_ACTION: review the default zero action dictionary used as the initial state for agent actions
